[[File:Flu.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] exhibiting flu-like symptoms.]]
The '''flu''' was a common disease prevalent in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was considered to be stronger than the [[Cold/Legends|cold]] but no worse than other major deadly diseases of the galaxy. It had no inherent targets, and seemed to target all [[Species/Legends|species]] indiscriminately. It had been suggested by [[Kal Skirata]] and [[Walon Vau]] that [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] have had the flu.
